dialogue:
[doctor] hi , marta . how are you today ?
[patient] hi doctor varga . my right knee has been hurting since i slipped on the ice in january .
[doctor] i'm sorry to hear that . you are fifty two , right ?
[patient] yes . i work as a mail carrier in oakridge , so i walk a lot .
[doctor] any swelling ?
[patient] a little . the pain is about six out of ten .
[doctor] okay . your blood pressure today is one forty over ninety , and your a1c last month was seven point two .
[doctor] let's get an x-ray of the right knee and keep the metformin five hundred milligrams twice a day .
note:
CHIEF COMPLAINT

Right knee pain.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS

Marta Lindqvist is a 52-year-old female mail carrier from Oakridge who presents with right knee pain after a fall on ice on 01/14/2026. Pain is 6/10 with mild swelling.

VITALS

Blood pressure: 140/90 mmHg.

RESULTS

Hemoglobin A1c: 7.2%.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN

1. Right knee pain after a fall. Order right knee x-ray.
2. Type 2 diabetes mellitus. Continue metformin 500 mg twice daily.

Dr. Ana Varga
